  0 < p.m →
    ∀ (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
      ENNReal.ofReal (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleProbability p) *
            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m ≤
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ (ENNReal.ofReal √↑p.m) ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (1 - outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleProbability p) *
            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleBatch p) ≤
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ (ENNReal.ofReal √↑p.m)
